{{dablink|For the [[horse]] owned by [[Galina Casban]], see [[Swift (horse)|Swift]].}}
The '''''Swift''''' is a river ship, captained by a man named [[Derne]]. It is "sleek as the bird" and is speedy true to its name.{{ref/book|3|49}}

==Activities==
After returning from [[Caemlyn]], [[Matrim Cauthon]] and [[Thomdril Merrilin]] take the ''Swift'' from [[Aringill]] to [[Tear]]. Mat pays Captain Derne two purses of gold for a fast trip.{{ref/book|3|49}}

==Crew==
*Derne - Captain
